Flytower 1.2.0 is about people and sharing. **People and roles**: invite people with a one-time link from the new **Access** page as an **Admin**, **Operator** or **Viewer**, for one server or all of them, or build your own roles from a list of permissions. Everyone sees only the servers and buttons they can use, and you become the **Owner** when you update. **Your account** (click your name in the sidebar) holds your name, theme, passkeys and recovery codes. Each server can also have a **public status page** at `/s/<server name>`, or on its own hostname, showing whether it's up, the address to join, who's online and, on Fabric, a `.mrpack` modpack to download. Re-run the installer once with the same `--domain` for hostnames to work.

Servers look more like themselves too. There's a rich-text **MOTD editor** with a live preview of the multiplayer list, an uploaded **server icon**, player **heads** on the Players tab (fetched by Flytower itself, never by a third-party site), and **branding** on System for your own name, colour, font and logo across the panel, sign-in, Discord and in-game messages. Resetting a world can keep the old one as a **past world** to download, share or import, and any backup can be kept forever. Client-only Modrinth projects can now be installed when you ask for them, with a warning in the plan.

Testing notes are in [testing-1.2.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0/docs/testing-1.2.0.md).
